scope: Public-source metadata framework for ancient Egyptian, Nubian, Predynastic, and underworld-related archaeological and textual traditions.
interpretation_note: Underworld is treated as a historical/religious subject category: beliefs, texts, iconography, tombs, funerary objects, and archaeological contexts. It is not treated as evidence of a literal physical underworld. 'Unders' is retained as an unresolved user-supplied term and is not assigned a historical meaning without a source.

periods.period: Third Intermediate and Late Periods, approximately 1070-332 BCE
Ptolemaic and Roman Egypt, 332 BCE-395 CE

egyptian_underworld_subjects: Duat/Dwꜣt as an ancient Egyptian afterlife concept
quality_rules: Distinguish Predynastic phases from later dynastic periods
Do not equate Nubia with Egypt; preserve distinct archaeological and political histories
Do not assume modern national borders apply to ancient contexts
Preserve original transliteration and translation where available
Distinguish primary evidence from modern interpretation
Do not treat religious descriptions of the Duat or other afterlife realms as physical geographic observations
Do not expose sensitive coordinates for vulnerable archaeological sites when publication would threaten preservation
source_families: National Museum of Sudan collections where publicly available
Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities/public heritage resources
limitations: Predynastic chronology varies by region and archaeological framework
Many archaeological objects lack secure original provenance
Looting and historic collecting can sever objects from context
Ancient texts survive unevenly and often through later copies
Translations and transliterations can change as scholarship develops
Some Nubian archaeological records were affected by displacement and salvage archaeology associated with dam construction
Not all museum or excavation metadata is openly digitized
security_privacy_boundary: public archaeological and scholarly metadata only
no disclosure of sensitive site coordinates where preservation could be harmed
status: Underworld, Egyptian, Nubian, and Predynastic metadata framework uploaded to Prev_NW.
